_about: Mike Step 14.1 (flashlight embedding), English. 'routing': zero-shot labels with a description and three anchor examples, and test sentences that never appear among the anchors. luna_action.description: an order to do something on the desktop: open, close, move or focus a window or an app
anchors: Put the calculator on the left.
